records.criterion: Document the action's actual behavior and why its current label does not make that effect apparent.

evidence.detail: conversation-surface-layout-study.md traces Show review threads to focus/select/expand/center of the first currently filtered thread root. It neither loads data, clears filters nor opens the drawer, and may focus an empty model, so 'Show' obscures its focus-only effect.

records.criterion: Replace the redundant gesture with a clear reachable behavior and before/after interaction.

evidence.detail: The selected design removes the drawer action, automatically reveals accepted PR-wide content in Discuss and permits only an Open discussions shortcut to that same state. The study records the inherited-filter blank before case and PR-wide result after case.

records.criterion: Define explicit accessible loading, no-threads, filtered-empty and failure states with no silent no-op.

evidence.detail: The selected state table distinguishes initial loading, accepted empty, filtered empty with active scope/Clear filters, refreshing, failed refresh, unavailable capability and authority replacement. BPR-0929 binds accessible runtime acceptance for the replacement flow.
